therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: multiple myeloma patients receiving induction therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: difference in touch detection thresholds from baseline to week 10

results.effect_size: Mean difference 0.06 (95% CI: -0.13-0.24) for fingertips, 0.05 (95% CI: -0.13-0.23) for thenar eminence, -0.12 (95% CI: -0.40-0.15) for volar forearm
subgroup_findings: No significant differences across anatomical sites (fingertips, thenar eminence, volar forearm)
results.dose_information: 200 mg by mouth for 1 dose, then 100 mg by mouth every 12 hours for 10 weeks
